seo.title: Manor Interiors – Plumbing, Heating & Home Improvements in Oxfordshire
seo.description: Family-run plumbing, heating and home improvement business in Cholsey, Oxfordshire, with over 30 years’ experience.

hero.lead: A family-run plumbing, heating and home improvement business in Oxfordshire, with over 30 years’ experience and every job completed to the highest standards.

heading: Quality and care
in every job.
services.intro: From a new boiler to a full renovation, one family-run team for plumbing, heating, kitchens, bathrooms and building work.

items.title: Plumbing & heating
items.text: Boilers installed, repaired and serviced, radiators, underfloor heating and power flushing.

items.title: Bathrooms & wet rooms
items.text: Bathroom design, installation and tiling, wet rooms and accessible showers.

items.title: Kitchens
items.text: Kitchen design, fitting, worktops and tiling.

items.title: Water softeners & hot water
items.text: Water softeners and unvented cylinders installed and maintained.

items.title: Building work
items.text: Extensions, garage and loft conversions, porches and plastering.

items.title: Carpentry & decorating
items.text: Joinery, garden rooms and interior decorating.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Call, or send the quote form with a few details. Photos help.

steps.title: We take a look
steps.text: We talk it through, look at the job and give you a clear quote.

steps.title: Job done properly
steps.text: The work is done with care and the site left clean and tidy.

heading: What customers
say about us.
reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: I've used Manor Interiors for over 10 years and highly recommend them to everyone! They initially installed an oil heating system into my old cottage… They have guided me through all the jargon and simply made the process of renovating stress free… Their quality of work is exceptional.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: They removed the wet unit, went and got me a great replacement and installed it for me. All the same day! It was amazing… Very professional and super friendly.
items.label: Which? review

quote.intro: Three quick steps and we’ll get back to you.

faqs.a: Yes. Manor Interiors is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.

faqs.q: Do you do more than plumbing?
faqs.a: Yes. As well as plumbing and heating, we design and fit kitchens and bathrooms and carry out building work such as extensions and conversions.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 07870 257119. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
